# Synthetic legacy save fixture

`legacy-v5-live.json` was generated by the development agent on 25 September 2026 using the public game code at commit `f2b1c858afb6252e50b0c4f17413ad2e39454a51`. It is test data, not an export of a user's career or browser storage. No browser storage was read to produce it.

Generation procedure with that revision's modules:

```js
const game = newGame('AZ');
beginMatch(game);
while (game.pending.minute < 32) {
  game.pending.paused = false;
  advanceMatch(game);
}
game.pending.paused = true;
makeSubstitution(game, game.pending.selection[2], game.pending.bench[1]);
// Serialize using exportBackup(game).
```

Names originate from the repository's public CC0 player dataset. The attributes, credits, team allocation, match events and score are generated by the game's deterministic simulation. The export timestamp records fixture generation. Keeping this immutable older output makes migration tests independent of future changes to `newGame()`.
